'''Jedi Masters''' is a cancelled Decipher expansion (CardGuide #35). It was scheduled for February 2001 as the second character-themed set after [[Skywalkers (expansion)|Skywalkers]]. It would have focused on Yoda, Obi-Wan, the Emperor, and their Imperial counterparts, and would have expanded the "Lichtenstein" mechanic (cards that grant new capabilities to existing characters rather than printing new versions of them).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="after">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050307015419/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/whatisit/afterdeathstar.html After Death Star II] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 March 2005)</ref>

No retail packaging was released. Encyclopedia 3.2 page 201 mock-up packs are not authentic product photography and are not used here.
